description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between “Cost” on the x-axis and “Reliability Score” on the y-axis for three different model ensemble configurations: a 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers), a 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers), and a single model baseline (yellow line with circular markers). The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” ranges from approximately 1 to 9 with major tick marks at 2, 4, 6, and 8, and appears to use a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” ranges from 30 to 90 with major tick marks at 50 and 70, also on a linear scale. The blue 3-Model Ensemble line starts at a reliability score of approximately 80 at cost ~1, rises slightly to ~82 at cost ~8.5, and ends near 85. The red 2-Model Ensemble line begins at ~78, increases steadily to ~83 at cost ~8.5, and ends near 86. In contrast, the yellow single-model line starts at ~80, declines to ~72 at cost ~4, and continues decreasing to ~60 at cost ~8.5. All lines are connected by solid segments between circular data points, with the 3-Model and 2-Model Ensembles showing positive trends while the single model shows a negative trend as cost increases.
